method.averaging: Task success pools all attempts. Task time averages15tasks/seed then gives both seeds50percent weight. Memory averages the2per-run peak system wired increases over median baseline. Decode gives2freshprocesses50percent weight each.
method.modelPolicy: Shipped automatic model-specific prefill and conversation anchors. Original benchmark samplers and explicit cache/context/output budgets retained.
method.scope: Serving profiles, not isolated runtime-version or model-weight comparisons; two seeds do not establish independence/statistical superiority. Memory is partial system-wide accounting; do not add it to weight sizes or interpret as total RAM requirement. No30Kanswer-quality or maximum-window quality claim.
method.preparations: Stopped, declined and launcher-failed preparation attempts excluded. Full scored cohort completed after user-authorized simulator shutdown under unchanged original pressure/swap/disk/capacity guards.
